findings.candidate_quote: with high-avidity clones associated with reduced recurrence risk
findings.reference_quote: a higher KLRB1/CD8A ratio showed a trend toward association with improved recurrence-free survival in HPV-positive cases
findings.explanation: The recurrence association concerned the bulk KLRB1/CD8A expression ratio, not TCR avidity. Higher-avidity clones were associated with persistence in the single longitudinal case; the summary incorrectly transfers the cohort-level prognostic association to avidity.

findings.candidate_quote: a 21.53 ± 1.01-fold increase in FITC-dextran leakage compared to 10.76 ± 0.69 in the control group
findings.explanation: These values describe relative fluorescence measurements, not fold increases. The reported treatment value is approximately twice the control value, not a 21.53-fold increase.

findings.candidate_quote: The findings associate miR-103b with these effects but do not establish causality or clinical relevance.
findings.reference_quote: ZO-1-labeled tight junctions were significantly reduced in HUVECs transfected with miR-103b-mimic compared to those in HUVECs transfected with the negative control miRNA
findings.explanation: The blanket denial of causality mischaracterizes controlled mimic interventions in cells and mice. These experiments support causal effects under the tested conditions, although physiological exosomal delivery, specific downstream mechanisms, and clinical relevance remain unestablished.
